parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kream_album_buffer (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  chat_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  media_group_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  caption TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_kream_album_unique
ON kream_album_buffer (chat_id, media_group_id, file_id);

SELECT *, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kream_album_buffer 
        WHERE media_group_id = $1) as total_count
FROM kream_album_buffer
WHERE media_group_id = $1
ORDER BY id ASC;
